related.title: VQE 量測工程：Pauli 項的樣本分配
related.titleEn: VQE measurement engineering: shot allocation among Pauli terms
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：同時報oracle成本與目標數，不能把所有資料庫讀取都當免費黑盒。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report oracle cost and target count; database access is not automatically a free black box. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 在固定量測預算下分配不同權重項的樣本，分開最佳化收斂與取樣誤差。
related.differenceEn: Allocate a fixed shot budget across weighted terms, separating optimizer convergence from sampling error.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。四個等振幅初態，一個目標，先做r=1次Grover迭代。 P=sin²(3π/6)。 代入 sin((2*1+1)*pi/6)**2，得到 1 success probability。單一目標N=4時sinθ=1/2、θ=π/6，r次迭代成功率sin²[(2r+1)θ]；假設理想oracle。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。a=1、b=2，總900shots，先均分nP=nQ=450；能量用教學單位。 Var(E)=1/450+4/450。 代入 1/450+4/450，得到 0.0111111 energy-unit squared。獨立量測E=a⟨P⟩+b⟨Q⟩時Var(E)=a²Var(P)/nP+b²Var(Q)/nQ；此例兩項單次變異數均1。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Start with four equal amplitudes and one target, applyingr=1 iteration. P=sin²(3π/6). Substituting sin((2*1+1)*pi/6)**2 gives 1 success probability. For one target amongN=4,θ=π/6 and success afterr iterations issin²[(2r+1)θ], assuming an ideal oracle. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. a=1,b=2,total900 shots, initially450 each; use teaching energy units. Var(E)=1/450+4/450. Substituting 1/450+4/450 gives 0.0111111 energy-unit squared. For independentE=a⟨P⟩+b⟨Q⟩,Var(E)=a²Var(P)/nP+b²Var(Q)/nQ; both single-shot variances are1 here. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IBM transmon：Josephson 能量與躍遷頻率
related.titleEn: IBM transmon: Josephson energy and transition frequency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：同時報oracle成本與目標數，不能把所有資料庫讀取都當免費黑盒。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report oracle cost and target count; database access is not automatically a free black box. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『IBM transmon：Josephson 能量與躍遷頻率』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付兩個頻率、反算結果及近似適用區間圖。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM transmon: Josephson energy and transition frequency', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver both frequencies, inverse results and an approximation-validity diagram.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。四個等振幅初態，一個目標，先做r=1次Grover迭代。 P=sin²(3π/6)。 代入 sin((2*1+1)*pi/6)**2，得到 1 success probability。單一目標N=4時sinθ=1/2、θ=π/6，r次迭代成功率sin²[(2r+1)θ]；假設理想oracle。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：當 E_J/E_C≫1，f01≈sqrt(8(E_J/h)(E_C/h))−E_C/h；所有頻率須同用 GHz。 使用教學 E_J/h=20 GHz、E_C/h=0.25 GHz，比例80；模型忽略更高階修正。 以手算或試算表計算名義式sqrt(8*20*0.25)-0.25，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以(f01+0.25)²/(8×0.25)反推 E_J/h，兩組應回到20與18。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Start with four equal amplitudes and one target, applyingr=1 iteration. P=sin²(3π/6). Substituting sin((2*1+1)*pi/6)**2 gives 1 success probability. For one target amongN=4,θ=π/6 and success afterr iterations issin²[(2r+1)θ], assuming an ideal oracle. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For E_J/E_C≫1, f01≈sqrt(8(E_J/h)(E_C/h))−E_C/h; all frequencies use GHz. Use Teaching E_J/h=20 GHz and E_C/h=0.25 GHz give ratio80; higher-order corrections are excluded. Evaluate nominal expression sqrt(8*20*0.25)-0.25 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Invert using(f01+0.25)²/(8×0.25); recover20 and18 for the two cases.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
